name: CSS Linear Gradient
description: CSS linear-gradient(): an optional direction and at least two color stops. Returns the gradient token value: a Dictionary with its kind, its angle in degrees and its stops, each with a color and a position from 0 to 1.

first.description: The direction (`to right`, `90deg`, `0.25turn`) or the first color stop

second.description: A color stop: a color, followed by one or two positions in percent
